shared.name: Āyat al-Kursī
shared.ar: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ ۚ لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ ۗ مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلَّا بِمَا شَاءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ ۖ وَلَا يَئُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ
shared.tr: Allāhu lā ilāha illā Huwal-Ḥayyul-Qayyūm. Lā ta’khudhuhū sinatun wa lā nawm. Lahū mā fis-samāwāti wa mā fil-arḍ. Man dhalladhī yashfaʿu ʿindahū illā bi’idhnih. Yaʿlamu mā bayna aydīhim wa mā khalfahum, wa lā yuḥīṭūna bishay’im-min ʿilmihī illā bimā shā’. Wasiʿa kursiyyuhus-samāwāti wal-arḍ, wa lā ya’ūduhū ḥifẓuhumā, wa Huwal-ʿAliyyul-ʿAẓīm.
shared.en: Allah alone deserves worship. He is Ever-Living and sustains all. Neither drowsiness nor sleep overtakes Him. He owns everything, knows everything, and preserving the heavens and earth does not tire Him.

shared.name: Sūrah Al-Ikhlāṣ
shared.ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ ۝ قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ ۝ اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ ۝ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ ۝ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ
shared.tr: Bismillāhir-Raḥmānir-Raḥīm. Qul Huwallāhu Aḥad. Allāhuṣ-Ṣamad. Lam yalid wa lam yūlad. Wa lam yakul-lahū kufuwan aḥad.
shared.en: Say: He is Allah, One; Allah, the Self-Sufficient. He neither begets nor was born, and nothing is comparable to Him.

shared.name: Sūrah Al-Falaq
shared.ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ ۝ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ ۝ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ ۝ وَمِنْ شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ ۝ وَمِنْ شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ ۝ وَمِنْ شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
shared.tr: Bismillāhir-Raḥmānir-Raḥīm. Qul aʿūdhu bi-Rabbil-falaq. Min sharri mā khalaq. Wa min sharri ghāsiqin idhā waqab. Wa min sharrin-naffāthāti fil-ʿuqad. Wa min sharri ḥāsidin idhā ḥasad.
shared.en: I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak from the evil of what He created, darkness when it settles, those who blow on knots, and an envier when they envy.

shared.name: Sūrah An-Nās
shared.ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ ۝ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ ۝ مَلِكِ النَّاسِ ۝ إِلَٰهِ النَّاسِ ۝ مِنْ شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ ۝ الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ ۝ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ
shared.tr: Bismillāhir-Raḥmānir-Raḥīm. Qul aʿūdhu bi-Rabbin-nās. Malikin-nās. Ilāhin-nās. Min sharril-waswāsil-khannās. Alladhī yuwaswisu fī ṣudūrin-nās. Minal-jinnati wan-nās.
shared.en: I seek refuge in the Lord, King and God of humankind from the whispering evil that retreats, which whispers into hearts, from jinn and people.

shared.name: Sayyid al-Istighfār
shared.ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي، فَاغْفِرْ لِي، فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
shared.tr: Allāhumma anta Rabbī lā ilāha illā ant. Khalaqtanī wa anā ʿabduk. Wa anā ʿalā ʿahdika wa waʿdika mastaṭaʿt. Aʿūdhu bika min sharri mā ṣanaʿt. Abū’u laka biniʿmatika ʿalayya wa abū’u bidhanbī, faghfir lī, fa’innahū lā yaghfirudh-dhunūba illā ant.
shared.en: O Allah, You are my Lord. You created me and I am Your servant. I remain faithful to Your covenant as far as I can. I seek refuge from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your blessings and my sins. Forgive me, for none forgives sins except You.

shared.name: Health, hearing and sight
shared.ar: اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَدَنِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي سَمْعِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَصَرِي، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكُفْرِ وَالْفَقْرِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
shared.tr: Allāhumma ʿāfinī fī badanī, Allāhumma ʿāfinī fī samʿī, Allāhumma ʿāfinī fī baṣarī, lā ilāha illā ant. Allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika minal-kufri wal-faqr, wa aʿūdhu bika min ʿadhābil-qabr, lā ilāha illā ant.
shared.en: O Allah, grant health to my body, hearing and sight. I seek refuge in You from disbelief, poverty and the punishment of the grave.

shared.name: Forgiveness and well-being
shared.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي، اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَاتِي وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِي، اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيَّ وَمِنْ خَلْفِي وَعَنْ يَمِينِي وَعَنْ شِمَالِي وَمِنْ فَوْقِي، وَأَعُوذُ بِعَظَمَتِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي
shared.tr: Allāhumma innī as’alukal-ʿafwa wal-ʿāfiyata fid-dunyā wal-ākhirah. Allāhumma innī as’alukal-ʿafwa wal-ʿāfiyata fī dīnī wa dunyāya wa ahlī wa mālī. Allāhummastur ʿawrātī wa āmin rawʿātī. Allāhummaḥfaẓnī min bayni yadayya wa min khalfī wa ʿan yamīnī wa ʿan shimālī wa min fawqī, wa aʿūdhu biʿaẓamatika an ughtāla min taḥtī.
shared.en: O Allah, grant me pardon and well-being in this world and the next, in my religion, family and possessions. Conceal my shortcomings, calm my fears and protect me from every direction.

shared.name: Protection from the soul and Shayṭān
shared.ar: اللَّهُمَّ عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ، فَاطِرَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي، وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطَانِ وَشِرْكِهِ، وَأَنْ أَقْتَرِفَ عَلَى نَفْسِي سُوءًا أَوْ أَجُرَّهُ إِلَى مُسْلِمٍ
shared.tr: Allāhumma ʿĀlimal-ghaybi wash-shahādah, Fāṭiras-samāwāti wal-arḍ, Rabba kulli shay’in wa malīkah, ash-hadu an lā ilāha illā ant. Aʿūdhu bika min sharri nafsī wa min sharrish-shayṭāni wa shirkih, wa an aqtarifa ʿalā nafsī sū’an aw ajurrahu ilā Muslim.
shared.en: O Allah, Knower of the unseen and the seen, Creator of the heavens and the earth, Lord and Owner of everything: I seek refuge from the evil of my soul and Satan, and from doing harm to myself or another Muslim.

shared.name: Bismillāhilladhī lā yaḍurru
shared.ar: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
shared.tr: Bismillāhilladhī lā yaḍurru maʿasmihī shay’un fil-arḍi wa lā fis-samā’i wa Huwas-Samīʿul-ʿAlīm.
shared.en: In Allah’s name, with whose name nothing on earth or in heaven can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, All-Knowing.

shared.name: Raḍītu billāhi Rabban
shared.ar: رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دِينًا وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَبِيًّا
shared.tr: Raḍītu billāhi Rabban, wa bil-Islāmi dīnan, wa bi-Muḥammadin ṣallallāhu ʿalayhi wa sallama Nabiyyan.
shared.en: I am pleased with Allah as Lord, Islam as religion and Muḥammad ﷺ as Prophet.

shared.name: Yā Ḥayyu yā Qayyūm
shared.ar: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ، أَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ، وَلَا تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ
shared.tr: Yā Ḥayyu yā Qayyūm, biraḥmatika astaghīth, aṣliḥ lī sha’nī kullahū, wa lā takilnī ilā nafsī ṭarfata ʿayn.
shared.en: O Ever-Living, O Sustainer, I seek help through Your mercy. Set all my affairs right and do not leave me to myself for even an instant.

shared.name: Lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdah
shared.ar: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
shared.tr: Lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahū lā sharīka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-ḥamd, wa Huwa ʿalā kulli shay’in qadīr.
shared.en: There is none worthy of worship except Allah alone, without partner. His is the dominion and praise, and He is capable of everything.

shared.name: Subḥānallāhi wa biḥamdih
shared.en: Glory and praise belong to Allah.

morning.name: Aṣbaḥnā wa aṣbaḥal-mulk
morning.ar: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَخَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَسُوءِ الْكِبَرِ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ
morning.tr: Aṣbaḥnā wa aṣbaḥal-mulku lillāh, wal-ḥamdu lillāh. Lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahū lā sharīka lah. Lahul-mulku wa lahul-ḥamd, wa Huwa ʿalā kulli shay’in qadīr. Rabbi as’aluka khayra mā fī hādhal-yawm wa khayra mā baʿdah, wa aʿūdhu bika min sharri mā fī hādhal-yawm wa sharri mā baʿdah. Rabbi aʿūdhu bika minal-kasali wa sū’il-kibar. Rabbi aʿūdhu bika min ʿadhābin fin-nāri wa ʿadhābin fil-qabr.
morning.en: We enter the morning acknowledging Allah’s dominion and praise. We ask for today’s good and what follows, and seek refuge from evil, laziness, the hardships of old age and punishment.

morning.name: Allāhumma bika aṣbaḥnā
morning.ar: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا وَبِكَ نَحْيَا وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ
morning.tr: Allāhumma bika aṣbaḥnā wa bika amsaynā, wa bika naḥyā wa bika namūt, wa ilaykan-nushūr.
morning.en: O Allah, by You we enter the morning and evening; by You we live and die; and to You is the resurrection.

morning.name: Beneficial knowledge and provision
morning.ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا، وَرِزْقًا طَيِّبًا، وَعَمَلًا مُتَقَبَّلًا
morning.tr: Allāhumma innī as’aluka ʿilman nāfiʿan, wa rizqan ṭayyiban, wa ʿamalan mutaqabbalan.
morning.en: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, wholesome provision and accepted deeds.

evening.name: Amsaynā wa amsal-mulk
evening.ar: أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَخَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهَا، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَسُوءِ الْكِبَرِ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ
evening.tr: Amsaynā wa amsal-mulku lillāh, wal-ḥamdu lillāh. Lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahū lā sharīka lah. Lahul-mulku wa lahul-ḥamd, wa Huwa ʿalā kulli shay’in qadīr. Rabbi as’aluka khayra mā fī hādhihil-laylah wa khayra mā baʿdahā, wa aʿūdhu bika min sharri mā fī hādhihil-laylah wa sharri mā baʿdahā. Rabbi aʿūdhu bika minal-kasali wa sū’il-kibar. Rabbi aʿūdhu bika min ʿadhābin fin-nāri wa ʿadhābin fil-qabr.
evening.en: We enter the evening acknowledging Allah’s dominion and praise. We ask for this night’s good and what follows, and seek refuge from evil, laziness, the hardships of old age and punishment.

evening.name: Allāhumma bika amsaynā
evening.ar: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا وَبِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا وَبِكَ نَحْيَا وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ
evening.tr: Allāhumma bika amsaynā wa bika aṣbaḥnā, wa bika naḥyā wa bika namūt, wa ilaykal-maṣīr.
evening.en: O Allah, by You we enter the evening and morning; by You we live and die; and to You is the final return.

evening.name: Perfect words of Allah
evening.ar: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
evening.tr: Aʿūdhu bikalimātillāhit-tāmmāti min sharri mā khalaq.
evening.en: I seek refuge in Allah’s perfect words from the evil of what He created.

shortDhikr.name: Two beloved phrases
shortDhikr.ar: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ
shortDhikr.en: Glory be to Allah, the Magnificent; glory be to Allah and praise Him. Two phrases light on the tongue, heavy on the scale, beloved to the Most Merciful.
shortDhikr.repetitionPolicy: open: no fixed narrated number in cited source

shortDhikr.name: A treasure of Paradise
shortDhikr.ar: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
shortDhikr.tr: Lā ḥawla wa lā quwwata illā billāh.
shortDhikr.en: There is no might or power except through Allah. Described by the Prophet ﷺ as a treasure from the treasures of Paradise.
shortDhikr.repetitionPolicy: open: no fixed narrated number in cited source

shortDhikr.name: Tawḥīd • 100 in a day
shortDhikr.ar: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
shortDhikr.tr: Lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahū lā sharīka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-ḥamd, wa Huwa ʿalā kulli shay’in qadīr.
shortDhikr.en: None deserves worship but Allah alone, without partner. His is the dominion and praise, and He has power over all things. Reciting this one hundred times in a day carries the immense reward narrated in the hadith.

generalWaking.name: Upon waking from sleep
generalWaking.ar: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
generalWaking.tr: Al-ḥamdu lillāhilladhī aḥyānā baʿda mā amātanā wa ilayhin-nushūr.
generalWaking.en: All praise belongs to Allah Who gave us life after causing us to die (sleep), and to Him is the resurrection.
generalWaking.repetitionPolicy: event-based optional personal log (not a fixed daily quota)

nightAwakening.name: When you awaken during the night
nightAwakening.ar: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، وَسُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ، وَلَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ، اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي
nightAwakening.tr: Lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahū lā sharīka lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-ḥamd, wa Huwa ʿalā kulli shay’in qadīr. Al-ḥamdu lillāh, wa subḥānallāh, wa lā ilāha illallāh, wallāhu akbar, wa lā ḥawla wa lā quwwata illā billāh. Allāhumma ighfir lī.
nightAwakening.en: None deserves worship except Allah alone, without partner. His is the dominion and all praise, and He is capable of everything. Praise Allah, glorify Him, declare His oneness and greatness, affirm that strength comes only through Him, then seek forgiveness and make duʿā’.
nightAwakening.repetitionPolicy: event-based optional personal log (not a fixed daily quota)
